title: Identification and verification of ferroptosis-related core gene in postmenopausal osteoporosis based on bioinformatics analysis.
authors: Ran, Dongcheng; Yang, Cheng; Zhou, Enyu; Li, Weimin; Xu, Jiamu; Wu, Wangxiang; Wang, Chunqing
one_liner_zh: 该文基于生物信息学分析绝经后骨质疏松症的铁死亡核心基因PTEN，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE AND BACKGROUND: Postmenopausal osteoporosis (PMOP) significantly increases the risk of fragility fractures and has substantial negative effects on patients. Accumulating evidence suggests that the pathogenesis of PMOP is associated with ferroptosis. In this study, we screened and validated core ferroptosis-related genes (FRGs) in PMOP and investigated their potential links using bioinformatics analysis. METHODS: Differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified between PMOP patients and healthy postmenopausal women based on the GSE230665 dataset in the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database. Weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) was conducted to sort and extract significant module genes. FRGs were acquired from an online ferroptosis database. By intersecting DEGs, FRGs, and significant module genes, we identified ferroptosis-associated DEGs (FDEGs). We performed Gene Ontology (GO), Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), and protein-protein interaction (PPI) analyses on FDEGs. Multiple algorithms within the cytoHubba plugin were employed to detect the core gene from the PPI network. The expression of the core gene was subsequently validated in the PMOP rat model, and the diagnostic efficacy of the core gene was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves applied to external datasets. GeneMANIA and Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) were conducted to explore important functions and pathways of the core gene. We further utilized the CIBERSORTx website to evaluate immune infiltration in PMOP and molecular docking analysis was performed to develop potential drugs for PMOP. Finally, we established a transcription factors (TFs)-mRNA-miRNAs regulatory network for mechanisms investigation. RESULTS: In this study, we identified phosphatase and tensin homologue deleted on chromosome 10 (PTEN) as the core gene through PPI analysis and various algorithms. qRT-PCR analysis and immunohistochemical staining revealed a significant elevation of PTEN expression in the PMOP rat models, and ROC curves demonstrated the relatively high diagnostic properties of PTEN. Moreover, GSEA analysis indicated that PTEN is involved in functions and pathways associated with MAPK signaling, oxidative phosphorylation, mTOR signaling, etc. We discovered three drugs that bind tightly to PTEN, including CX-5461, UMI-77, and GSK2256098. Ultimately, we constructed a TFs-mRNA-miRNAs network comprising 39 nodes (16 TFs, 22 miRNAs, and 1 mRNA) and 38 edges. CONCLUSION: PTEN was preliminarily identified and verified as a key ferroptosis gene in postmenopausal osteoporosis through bioinformatics analysis, and the diagnostic model constructed based on PTEN was of high value. These findings may provide novel perspectives on the pathogenesis of PMOP at the transcriptome level and establish a theoretical foundation for further research.
abstract_zh: 目的与背景：绝经后骨质疏松症（PMOP）显著增加脆性骨折风险，并对患者产生重大负面影响。越来越多的证据表明，PMOP的发病机制与铁死亡（ferroptosis）相关。在本研究中，我们筛选并验证了PMOP中的核心铁死亡相关基因（FRGs），并利用生物信息学分析探讨了它们的潜在关联。方法：基于基因表达综合（GEO）数据库中的GSE230665数据集，识别了PMOP患者与健康绝经后女性之间的差异表达基因（DEGs）。采用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）对显著模块基因进行分类和提取。从在线铁死亡数据库获取FRGs。通过交集DEGs、FRGs和显著模块基因，我们鉴定了铁死亡相关差异表达基因（FDEGs）。对FDEGs进行了基因本体论（GO）、京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）分析。利用cytoHubba插件中的多种算法从PPI网络中检测核心基因。随后在PMOP大鼠模型中验证了核心基因的表达，并使用外部数据集通过受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线评估了核心基因的诊断效能。进行了GeneMANIA和基因集富集分析（GSEA）以探索核心基因的重要功能和通路。我们进一步利用CIBERSORTx网站评估PMOP中的免疫浸润，并进行分子对接分析以开发PMOP的潜在药物。最后，我们建立了转录因子（TFs）-mRNA-miRNAs调控网络以探究机制。结果：在本研究中，我们通过PPI分析和多种算法确定了第10号染色体上缺失的磷酸酶和张力蛋白同源物（PTEN）为核心基因。qRT-PCR分析和免疫组织化学染色显示，PMOP大鼠模型中PTEN表达显著升高，ROC曲线证明了PTEN相对较高的诊断特性。此外，GSEA分析表明PTEN参与与MAPK信号、氧化磷酸化、mTOR信号等相关的功能和通路。我们发现了三种与PTEN紧密结合的药物，包括CX-5461、UMI-77和GSK2256098。最终，我们构建了一个包含39个节点（16个TFs、22个miRNAs和1个mRNA）和38条边的TFs-mRNA-miRNAs网络。结论：通过生物信息学分析，PTEN被初步鉴定并验证为绝经后骨质疏松症中的关键铁死亡基因，基于PTEN构建的诊断模型具有较高价值。这些发现可能在转录组水平为PMOP的发病机制提供新视角，并为进一步研究奠定理论基础。
